items.q: What does she say the creation story is for?
items.a: A set of **instructions**: live in balance, take only what you need, give thanks, and **protect what gives you life**. Under Yurok stewardship the Klamath runs were the **third largest** in the continental US.

items.q: What did the dams do to the salmon?
items.a: No fish passage blocked more than **400 miles** of spawning grounds. Runs fell to **5 percent** of historical abundance. Reservoirs emitted methane equal to **64,000 cars** a year. In 2002 more than **70,000** adult salmon died.

items.q: Why did the dams come out?
items.a: Litigation required **fish ladders** to keep operating. Removal was cheaper. A **$500 million** settlement took out **four dams** in 2023 and 2024. Restoration runs through **2028**.

items.q: How fast did the river answer?
items.a: Three days after **Iron Gate** was breached, salmon passed grounds closed for **100 years**. About **7,000** the first year and **13,000** in 2025. Crews have planted **20 billion** native seeds.
